title: Linked-issue comment job runs after publish-draft and holds its own narrow permissions
answers: why does the linked issue comment job depend on publish-draft
which permissions does the copilot-agent comment job need
order of jobs in copilot-agent workflow
body:
Invariant: comment-on-linked-issues is ordered behind publish-draft via 'needs: publish-draft', so issues are notified only after the Copilot PR has been marked ready for review.
Enforced: .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml, job comment-on-linked-issues (needs: and job-level permissions block).
Permissions are declared per job: issues: write to post comments, pull-requests: read for the closingIssuesReferences query. Add new grants to this job rather than workflow-wide.
What breaks: removing needs lets notifications run without the draft-publish step having completed; widening permissions at workflow level gives publish-draft write scope it does not use.
applies: Jobs in .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml; applies to any new job that depends on the publish step or writes to issues.
says: Linked issues receive comments before the assistant pull request is published and ready for review.
Stop posting comments on linked tickets while the generated pull request is still a draft.
Only notify referenced issues once the automated pull request has been marked ready for review.
Subscribed issue owners are alerted too early before the bot pull request is ready.
search: In `.github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml`, the `comment-on-linked-issues` job must depend on `publish-draft` via `needs: publish-draft` so issues are only notified after the Copilot pull request is marked ready for review. Job-level permissions must be declared directly on `comment-on-linked-issues` (`issues: write` and `pull-requests: read`) rather than workflow-wide, preventing `publish-draft` from receiving unneeded write scope.
